sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture off the back of a recent loss, but their longer-term form remains strong with seven wins from their last six matches. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just four points and arrive in poor form, having won only once all season, making this a winnable encounter for Sandbach.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town, another chance for them to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two top-six teams, with both sides looking to rebuild after recent defeats. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash, while Bilston Town entertain Foley Meir on home soil. Barnton welcome Shawbury United; the visitors are in alarming form with six consecutive losses and sit in the bottom half. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a fixture between sides separated by just two points in the table. Brereton Social face Widnes Town, the division's basement club who have collected just two points all season. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle between two of the struggling sides near the foot of the table. Crewe host Allscott Heath as they attempt to climb away from the lower reaches of the division.
